artifacts.lookFor: The approved flow, six stages: Who · Mode · Aspects · Create · Sent · Ongoing. Templates are pre-stage views (the button is Create Relationship and it enters Stage 1), the invite is account-free, payment is a soft prompt at the invite ($9.95/mo one relationship, $19.85/mo unlimited) and a hard gate at publish, the account step comes after Stage 4, and the Aspects collapse to one row and reorder by drag.
The version in review: all ten stages in order, each naming the person who acts, and the Gap appearing only where both parties have accepted.
The same ten stages as v2 with a fuller copy pass — read the stage rail and the Aspects step against the flow the app renders today.
Where the account step sits between Basics and Who — the stage v1 did not have, which is why the flow went from six stages to ten.
The original six stages from template choice to alignment — read the count against the ten the model defines now.
